body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-17 16:06Z). A worker that ends a NAMING turn ("binding turn ends, RED edits next own wake") will NOT be re-invoked by anything unless someone sends it a message. Naming takes effect at its next turn, but no event creates that turn. ALWAYS send an immediate CONTINUE wake when a worker reports a naming-only turn. Better: tell workers in the original instruction to name and then send THEMSELVES nothing; they should mail me "named", and I reply CONTINUE at once. This is the same deadlock class as w-d9f93ea08fd2.
